desc:
Huh... assuming all those coils to be one single spine would mean that it's a snake. 🤔 However, I think it might be more likely that they're really separate bones. First is the spine to the bottom; to her right, parallel bones; and to her left, ribs.

Oh, right. And we must note that they're not actually bones – they're fossils. They were bones, but here they are **stones.**
